additional_context.rule: reuse the saved equal-weight mean of all five historical component OOFs; do not retrain or select seeds

seed_roles.data_random_seed: active: Dataset construction samples rows to construct histogram bins
seed_roles.drop_seed: inactive: gbdt does not use DART dropout
seed_roles.feature_fraction_seed: inactive: feature_fraction=1.0; no per-tree feature subset is sampled
seed_roles.objective_seed: inactive: binary objective needs no random sampling
seed_roles.seed: explicit root seed; explicit child seed parameters take precedence

dataset_construction.challenger_pattern: same shared Dataset constructor, _update_params with challenger params, construct once, then Dataset.subset(sorted(train_idx)) per saved fold
dataset_construction.control_pattern: lgb.Dataset(X, label, weight, feature_name, free_raw_data=False); lgb.cv applies params before construct; each fold uses Dataset.subset(sorted(train_idx))

data.purge_rule: reuse saved train/validation indices; label availability <= first validation nominal decision time

economics.policy: existing independent fixed-$5, net-EV >= 1%, T-60 decision and T-59 execution simulator, fees, depth, and settlement cutoff

specification.hypothesis: With 70 selected features and weak signal, per-tree feature subsampling may reduce forecast stability; this is a hypothesis, not an established cause.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over 3-day UTC blocks

daily_log_growth.not_applicable: independent orders; no portfolio capital base

ENSEMBLE.drawdown_accounting: not applicable to independent orders; no portfolio capital base or cash constraint
ENSEMBLE.expected_value: payout probability times net shares less full gross spend and cash collateral fee; optional T-60 hurdle is net EV divided by requested gross stake
ENSEMBLE.settlement_release: max(Gamma closedTime, market start + 5 minutes) + 60 seconds; same convention for all policies
ENSEMBLE.side_selection_rule: positive net EV side at requested amount
